zetaris.description: Federates 5 siloed crime datasets across 3 police jurisdictions without ETL, executing cross-source joins across incidents, forensics, CCTV, and witness reports.

meterless_engines.world_model: Maintains shared investigation state and canonical entity resolution across Planner, Finder, Analyst, and Skeptic agents.
meterless_engines.hmem: Bounded human-in-the-loop memory recording investigator approvals and rejections to adjust future link confidence weights (+-0.08 cap).

nightshift.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway routing NVIDIA Nemotron models. Zero raw API keys in application code; all requests logged with model name and receipt IDs.

compliance.responsible_ai: Incident-level linking only; no personal scoring or protected attribute profiling. All alerts require human verification.
compliance.privacy: Automated EXIF and metadata stripping on public witness/CCTV submissions.
